issues.where: western hemisphere and left limb (crops B, D, G, H, N, O)
issues.what: The surface looks airbrushed and painterly. Detail smears into soft, blurry patches, and the cloud and haze layer reads as a brushed overlay rather than real atmosphere. It falls apart at native size.
issues.fix: Regenerate or upscale with real high-frequency terrain detail near the limb. Keep the atmospheric haze as a thin, physically graded layer, not a smear over the terrain.

issues.where: Valles Marineris centre (crops A, F, P, Q)
issues.what: A bushy, feather-like blob sits in the canyon, along with a dark plume that looks like an explosion or plant. These are invented shapes that give away that the image is generated.
issues.fix: Paint out the feather and plume shapes. Replace them with eroded canyon walls and chasma floor texture that matches the rest of the rift.

issues.where: lower right, dark side near terminator
issues.what: Bright, broken, hook-shaped strokes float on the dark surface. They read like random squiggles or glyphs rather than lit crater rims.
issues.fix: Remove the stray highlights, or replace them with continuous, correctly lit crater rims that fade into shadow.

issues.what: The moon's surface is soft and plasticky with mushy crater edges. Its edge against Mars has a slight cut-out look, with no matching light or shadow.
issues.fix: Sharpen the regolith and crater detail, light it to match the sun direction on Mars, and clean up the matte edge.

issues.where: dark sky (crops S, T, J, W)
issues.what: A faint 8 px block grid shows in the near-black sky, from compression or upscaling. Many stars are soft, multi-pixel blobs.
issues.fix: Denoise or deband the sky without block artifacts, export at higher quality, and use crisp point-like stars.

issues.where: terminator and right limb (crops C, E, I, M, R)
issues.what: The night side has faint wavy streak texture and a muddy gradient. The thin rim glow on the dark limb is uneven.
issues.fix: Smooth the terminator falloff with dithering, and make the dark-limb atmospheric scatter even and faint.

issues.what: The spiral is soft and smudgy, and its edges have a halo where it blends into the terrain.
issues.fix: Add fine structure to the cloud bands and feather the edge of the layer so it casts subtle shadow onto the ground.

issues.where: north polar cap, top edge (crops K, L)
issues.what: The polar cap is cropped by the frame edge and its texture breaks into blotchy white patches.
issues.fix: Reframe, or rebuild the cap with coherent layered ice texture.

issues.where: polar cap, tile K in image-15.png / tile B in image-14.png
issues.what: the ice cap is a soft, airbrushed smear of swirls, visibly blurrier than the sharply textured terrain around it, and small detached bright fragments float off its lower-left edge
issues.fix: repaint the cap with crisper, small-scale ice texture at the same detail level as the surrounding disc and blend the stray bright chunks back into the surface

issues.where: night side, left of terminator, tile A in image-14.png
issues.what: faint bluish cloud wisps sit on the unlit disc with nothing to light them, reading as a pasted layer
issues.fix: darken or remove the wisps on the night side so clouds only read where the sun can reach them

issues.where: mid-right mesa in deep shadow, tile E in image-10.png
issues.what: the shadowed rock and haze pool are soft and muddy at native size compared with the crisp ridges nearby
issues.fix: add fine grain and gently sharpen the shadow detail so it matches the lit slopes, keeping the haze falloff smooth
